title: Uncaught TypeError: y is not a function - bundled version of preact@10.0.5 errors when executing code compiled with Webpack
explanation: The issue describes a bug that is preventing the user from successfully upgrading to a newer version of the InstantSearch library, causing errors when the code is compiled and minified. The frustration and confusion emotions are evident from the technical details provided and the inability to resolve the issue despite downgrading to an older version of Preact.
